policies.description: Damped-least-squares differential IK push controller with a four-phase approach/descend/push/hold machine; nominal kinematics, no learning.

v1 damped-least-squares IK push controller plus a repair for the G10 counterexample: vertical speed capped at 0.05 m/s below 6 cm and push height 3.0 cm. Classical, no learning. Identity hashes v1 and v2 sources.
